maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Indoor Roller Painting Robot (室内辊涂机器人)
name: Bright Dream indoor roller painting robot
summary: Indoor robot that applies latex paint or wallpaper primer to walls and bay windows with a roller instead of a spray gun, in flats, offices and shops. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Application
specs.value: roller application of latex paint or wallpaper base coat on walls and bay windows
specs.quote: 主要用于住宅室内墙面、飘窗的乳胶漆或墙纸基膜自动辊涂作业

specs.label: Coverage
specs.conditions: share of the surface the robot covers

notes: Rolls rather than sprays, so no overspray masking is needed. Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.
